title: Check Failed SSH Logins
description: Count recent failed SSH authentication attempts from system logs.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

SINCE="${SINCE:-24 hours ago}"

COUNT=$(journalctl --since "$SINCE" --no-pager 2>/dev/null |
    grep -Eic 'Failed password|authentication failure|Invalid user' || true)

echo "Failed SSH authentication events since $SINCE: $COUNT"
